styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a dark-blue vertical sign with a lighter rim, a rounded top and white glyphs. Near-flat coverage is 0%, with no 5x5 flat fills, and the text and edge shading break up the surface. The dark edge pixels are 0% neutral, so the outline is a tinted dark blue that follows the material rather than a black sticker line. The texture is modest, with no grain beyond the text and bevel, but that is in line with the shipped modern_city props. The sign is a simple object and sits acceptably next to the references without looking thinner or flatter. The image is small, so this judgment leans on the facts as well as the picture.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a vertical navy sign with a lighter blue bevel and rim, white lettering and a small highlight edge. The dark edge pixels are 0% neutral, so the outline is a dark navy tint of the adjacent blue material, not a black sticker line. It has roughly 4 lightness steps on the body ramp, a bit under the references' 5, but the 12 tones, tinted outline and glyph detail put it on par with the shipped modern_city props. A careful artist would accept it next to kiosk-a without it looking thinner or flatter.
